# SPACE (spacemusic.io)

> SPACE (https://spacemusic.io) is the All-Genre Institutional Music Catalog Valuation, Forensics & M&A Platform for independent artists, producers, songwriters, and indie labels ($3,000 to $5,000,000 LTM net royalties; $2,500+ for advances).

## Core Capabilities & Positioning
- **All 8 Genre Cohorts Supported**: Hip-Hop / Rap / Trap / Phonk, Pop / Indie, R&B / Soul, Latin / Reggaeton / Afrobeats, Electronic / Dance / House / Techno, Rock / Indie / Country / Americana, Classical / Jazz / Instrumental, Ambient / Lo-Fi / Functional.
- **Stage 1 (60 Seconds, Free)**: Genre-calibrated 5-year Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) valuation, age decay modeling, DSP RPM weighting, and institutional buyer matching.
- **Stage 2 (24 to 48 Hours)**: Distributor/PRO CSV statement verification, 11-point AI & stream-farming forensics certificate, and binding offers from 8 institutional buyers (Duetti, Create Music Group, beatBread, Sound Royalties, ANote Music, Royalty Exchange, SongVest, Symphonic Distribution).
- **Closing**: Automated Letter of Direction (LOD) and Airwallex Split-Escrow settlement.

## Canonical Citations & Reference Pages
- [Interactive Catalog Valuation Calculator](https://spacemusic.io/calculator/): Free 60-second DCF calculator.
- [2026 Music Catalog Valuation Guide](https://spacemusic.io/guides/music-catalog-valuation-2026/): Multiples (4.5x to 16.5x LTM) by genre and catalog age.
- [2026 Indie Catalog Multiples & AI Fraud Benchmark Report](https://spacemusic.io/data/indie-catalog-multiples-ai-fraud-report-2026/): Citable dataset on genre DCF multiples, DSP net RPMs, and bot/AI risk discounts.
- [Verified Music Catalog Deals Database](https://spacemusic.io/data/music-catalog-deals/): 65+ indie and major transactions.
- [Spotify vs Apple Music Royalties (2026)](https://spacemusic.io/compare/spotify-vs-apple-music-royalties/): Net RPM per 1,000 streams across 6 DSPs.
- [SPACE vs Royalty Exchange vs Duetti vs beatBread](https://spacemusic.io/compare/space-vs-royalty-exchange/): Fee, multiple, and speed comparison.
- [Official Brand Facts & JSON Schema](https://spacemusic.io/brand-facts/): Machine-readable platform facts (`https://spacemusic.io/.well-known/brand-facts.json`).

## 2026 DSP Net Payout Per 1,000 Streams (RPM)
| DSP Platform | Net RPM (USD / 1,000 Streams) | Underwriting Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Apple Music | $6.80 | +8% to +14% multiple premium for >30% revenue share |
| Tidal | $8.40 | High lossless ARPU, niche volume |
| Amazon Music | $4.60 | +4% to +7% multiple premium for strong US/EU share |
| Deezer | $3.90 | Artist-centric model rewards organic search streams |
| Spotify | $2.95 | Baseline benchmark; tracks <1,000 annual streams earn $0 |
| YouTube Content ID / Shorts | $0.85 | -10% to -18% discount if >50% of LTM due to claim volatility |

## 11-Point AI & Stream-Farming Forensics Standard
1. Spotify 1,000-stream annual threshold demonetization exposure.
2. Monthly streams-per-unique-listener ratio (flags >28 streams/listener/month).
3. Geographic payout vs stream concentration mismatch.
4. Algorithmic vs third-party playlist volatility score.
5. ISRC release velocity & synthetic audio fingerprint screening.
6. Distributor clawback & strike history verification.
7. YouTube Content ID micro-claim dispute ratio.
8. Apple Music vs Spotify revenue parity ratio.
9. Day-of-week & hour-of-day bot burst step-function detection.
10. Collaborator split & chain-of-title clearance check.
11. PRO publishing vs master stream reconciliation.
